answer: Operator-Linked Credential Revocation: every wallet must carry a quill-signed operator credential tied to a hardware-attested host and billing account. The protocol aggregates wallets per operator; a sybil-like burst trips an ocean-wide throttle that revokes the operator’s credential and issuance rights, leaving wallet balances untouched. Re-attestation needs fresh timber-grade infrastructure audits and downtime. Attacker cost: lost operator accounts, prepaid compute, and weeks of re-certification, not individual wallets.
